limits: A verified fix or predicate_spot_checked classification covers only the recorded source clause and cited cases; it does not certify full behavior of the card.

All 82 residual rows from the finite 140-card conditional scan were spot reviewed. A zero remaining review queue refers to this finite index, not every interaction or every source card.
The source snapshot has 577 cards. Registry coverage, finite source-clause review, and live-game parity remain different claims.
Commit IDs are local review provenance. Reproduce against retained test paths and source fixtures in the final published tree.
The compact predicate index retains up to three test references per card; each reference is bounded evidence for its named case.

source_draw_mutations_and_delayed_effect.scope: Actual draws versus hand movement, combat-only cost/damage changes, one delayed explosion, selected-turn retention and installed Power lifecycle.

source_any_card_listener.scope: Any-card listener matches the tested playable card types.

other_player_attack_formula.scope: Other-player Attack instances on the target this turn, including blocked hits and replay/reload. Osty is not inferred to be another player; this is printed-text grouping, not full co-op parity.

typed_x_cost_family.scope: 75 public raw-source cases cover Energy versus Star payment, base/upgraded, zero X, Chemical X for both resources, repeat/Evoke, original-X replay and free autoplay using current resources. Does not certify every card interaction.

finite_conditional_spot_audit.scope: Finite source-clause, normalized-plan and named-adapter review with retained public test references. Test references are a navigation index and bounded predicate evidence, not a full card parity assertion.

publication_provenance.commit_ids_scope: All commit IDs in this inventory identify local review provenance. Individual worker or integration commits are not assumed reachable in public history.
publication_provenance.primary_reproduction_evidence: Retained test paths and source fixtures at the published checkout, plus source snapshot hashes and URLs.
publication_provenance.public_revision: The publishing workflow records the final public revision and validated tree hash outside this inventory, in its deliverable or PR validation log.
